strings.name: Andy Murray
strings.summary: Andy Murray reached the top of men’s tennis with counterpunching, returning and all-court movement. He won three singles majors, two Olympic singles golds and reached No.1 in 2016. He returned after injury and hip surgery before retiring after the Paris 2024 Olympics, then tried coaching to pass on his experience.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: A Grand Slam and Olympic singles champion who changed British modern tennis’s international competitive standing.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Junior training in Scotland; moved to Barcelona’s Sánchez-Casal Academy at fifteen
strings.highlights.h1.title: Major and Olympic titles
strings.highlights.h1.text: 2012 US Open, 2013 and 2016 Wimbledon; Olympic singles gold in 2012 and 2016.
strings.highlights.h2.title: No.1 and team contribution
strings.highlights.h2.text: Year-end No.1 in 2016 and part of Britain’s 2015 Davis Cup triumph.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Temporary support for Draper
strings.timeline.t1.text: Announced as part of Jack Draper’s support team for the grass season.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Paris farewell and coaching
strings.timeline.t2.text: Retired after the Olympics; joined Djokovic in November, ending the partnership in May 2025.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Return after hip surgery
strings.timeline.t3.text: Resumed professional competition after hip-resurfacing surgery.
strings.timeline.t4.title: World No.1 season
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won Wimbledon and Olympic singles again and finished the year ranked first.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Davis Cup champion
strings.timeline.t5.text: Beat David Goffin in the final as Britain won its first title since 1936.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Wimbledon champion
strings.timeline.t6.text: Ended Britain’s 77-year wait for a men’s singles champion there.
strings.timeline.t7.title: US Open and Olympic breakthrough
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won London singles gold, then his first major at the US Open.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Turned professional
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered professional tennis and reached Wimbledon’s third round on debut.
